formal_target_rows.claim: A positive nondecreasing two-pool portfolio exists iff r*p >= (1-a)*(1-d).
The explicit witness (r,1-a) is stationary at equality and has strict durable growth above threshold.

nonvacuity_obligations: carbon_continuity_nonvacuous proves the concrete strict-threshold model (a,d,r,p)=(3/5,4/5,1/2,1/5) with positive portfolio (L,D)=(1/2,2/5)
carbon_continuity_threshold_sufficient retains strict positivity of r and p and constructs a strictly positive portfolio
carbon_continuity_threshold_necessary retains strict positivity of L and D so cancellation is load-bearing

empirical_claims: Management interventions may alter retention or transfer coefficients.
The threshold may inform stewardship and carbon-risk contracts.

falsifiable_prediction.observable: Per-cycle retained fractions a and d, transfer coefficients r and p, and whether a calibrated positive living/durable carbon portfolio is nondecreasing under the declared two-pool transition model.
falsifiable_prediction.predicted: Within that fixed model, such a portfolio exists exactly when r*p >= (1-a)*(1-d).
falsifiable_prediction.refuted_if: A correctly calibrated cycle satisfying the model assumptions is observed to violate the threshold classification; systematic model misfit instead invalidates application of the theorem to that system.

candidate_evidence.name: Carbon Continuity After Wildfire
candidate_evidence.nontrivial_justification: The package proves both directions of an exact existence threshold, plus boundary stationarity, strict growth, and a concrete rational witness. The result is algebraic and model-scoped; it is not merely a numerical replay or an assertion of ecological truth. The current Viridis canon index contains no duplicate statement at the configured similarity threshold; no broader literature-priority claim is made.
candidate_evidence.statement: For the fixed two-pool nonnegative carbon transition model with positive retained and transfer coefficients, a strictly positive nondecreasing portfolio exists if and only if r*p is at least (1-a)*(1-d); the boundary witness is stationary and becomes strictly growing above the threshold.
candidate_evidence.witness: The exact rational model (a,d,r,p,L,D)=(3/5,4/5,1/2,1/5,1/2,2/5) satisfies all interval and strict-positivity hypotheses, has r*p=1/10>(1-a)*(1-d)=2/25, and gives a strictly growing positive portfolio.
